description: Source code implementing message building functions for different section types in a communication protocol, including encoding, serialization, and message construction for radio channel, idle guard period, and PRACH messages.

methods.name: encode_frame_structure
methods.description: Encodes subcarrier spacing and FFT size into a single byte.

methods.name: encode_data_direction
methods.description: Encodes data direction, payload version, and filter index into a byte.

methods.name: encode_subframe_and_slot
methods.description: Encodes subframe index and slot index into a byte.

methods.name: encode_slot_and_start_symbol
methods.description: Encodes slot index and start symbol into a byte.

methods.name: encode_sect_id_rb_symbols
methods.description: Encodes section ID, resource block info, and symbol info into a byte.

methods.name: encode_re_mask_and_nof_symbols
methods.description: Encodes RE mask and number of symbols into a byte.

methods.name: serialize_section_0_1_3_5_fields
methods.description: Serializes common section fields for types 0,1,3,5.

methods.name: serialize_section1_extensions
methods.description: Serializes extensions for section type 1 (not supported).

methods.name: build_dl_ul_radio_channel_message
methods.description: Builds a DL/UL radio channel message into a buffer.

methods.name: to_cplane_scs_value
methods.description: Converts subcarrier spacing enum to protocol-specific value.

methods.name: encode_cp_length
methods.description: Encodes CP length; returns 0 as placeholder.

methods.name: serialize_section0_extensions
methods.description: Serializes extensions for section type 0 (not supported).

methods.name: build_idle_guard_period_message
methods.description: Builds an idle/guard period message into a buffer.

methods.name: build_prach_mixed_numerology_message
methods.description: Builds a PRACH mixed numerology message into a buffer.
